workflow_definition.aggregation_logic: Group members debate locally, representatives merge group summaries, and a shared final judge selects the final answer.
conditional_edges: group_dispatch -> group_debate_round (parallel Send fan-out) else group_controller
group_controller -> group_dispatch | representative_dispatch
representative_dispatch -> representative_merge (parallel Send fan-out) else final_judge
representative_controller -> representative_dispatch | final_judge
workflow_definition.dispatch_logic: Debate is local to groups until the controller emits representative-only summaries. Inter-group traffic is restricted to representative packets.

nodes.group_dispatch: Fan out the intra-group debate stage.

stopping_criteria: No meaningful change between group or representative revisions
